title: VELL — An articulated collectible from a flat character, 14 deliverables

config.text:
# VELL — original character and articulated collectible records

## Source and commission

- Character: VELL.
- Character description: quiet seedling wanderer.
- Product: one complete articulated collectible for adult display and posing.
- Development route: one coherent three-dimensional translation of the supplied front identity.
- Identity source: vell-front-2d.png; the character owner's flat front illustration.
- Source image authority: visible front character identity, front silhouette and colour relationships.
- Dimensional authority: client height record and designer-declared component dimensions.
- Image rights: held by the character owner; cleared for this commission.
- Client text rights: held by the client; cleared for this commission.
- Final visual treatment: rounded solid toy volumes with material rendering.

## Fixed front identity

| Region | Fixed record |
|---|---|
| Head | Broad cream head |
| Head tips | Exactly two separate green leaf-like tips, fixed to the head |
| Eyes | Two navy vertical ovals |
| Mouth | One tiny curved navy smile |
| Cheeks | Exactly three coral dots on character-left cheek; character-right cheek plain |
| Side convention | Character-left is viewer-right in the supplied front image |
| Torso | Teal pear-shaped volume |
| Belly | One yellow diamond-shaped patch on the torso front, integral surface marking |
| Arms and hands | Two short cream arms, each with one integrated rounded mitten-like hand |
| Legs | Two short navy leg segments |
| Feet | Two broad rounded navy feet |
| Expression across states | Same eye marks, mouth and anatomical cheek placement |
| External feature inventory | Head, two leaf tips, eyes, smile, three cheek dots, torso, belly diamond, two arms/hands, two leg segments, two feet |

## Three-dimensional interpretation

- Fixed proportion relationships: broad head, pear-shaped body and short limbs.
- Open volume decisions: depth, unseen back and small proportion adjustments for articulation.
- Open assembly decisions: mechanism types, axis positions, part cuts and seam treatment.
- Body form: rounded solids with individually resolved depth and surface transitions.
- Rear colour continuity: cream head, green leaf tips, teal torso and navy lower limbs continuing their source regions.
- Facial graphics location: front head surface.
- Yellow diamond location: torso front surface.
- Leaf-tip attachment: both tips fixed as part of the head throughout every state.
- Surface graphic treatment: source outline translated through the chosen surface and seam treatment.
- Arm attachment: physical shoulder connections to the torso.
- White gaps beside the illustrated arms: drawing separation.
- Palette source: relative cream, green, navy, coral, teal and yellow relationships in vell-front-2d.png.
- Production-intent palette: exact colour codes selected and recorded by the designer.
- Surface allocation: actual matte and satin finishes selected and recorded by region.
- View continuity: resolved back geometry, depth, part dimensions and seams carried into details and poses.
- Mark visibility: perspective and occlusion according to the fixed anatomical locations.

## Body units

| ID | Unit | Quantity | Construction relationship |
|---|---|---:|---|
| H | Head | 1 | Head and both fixed leaf tips moving together |
| T | Torso | 1 | Pear-shaped body with integral front diamond marking |
| AR | Right arm/hand | 1 | One rigid arm and mitten unit |
| AL | Left arm/hand | 1 | One rigid arm and mitten unit |
| LR | Right leg segment | 1 | One rigid leg segment |
| LL | Left leg segment | 1 | One rigid leg segment |
| FR | Right foot | 1 | Broad rounded foot |
| FL | Left foot | 1 | Broad rounded foot |

- Total body units: eight.
- Pose, display and video assembly: all eight units attached.
- Exploded assembly representation: separated parts with their connecting relationships identified.

## Articulated connections

| ID | Anatomical connection | Connected units | Nominal motion target |
|---|---|---|---|
| JN | Head-to-torso | H–T | Yaw at least 30 degrees to either side of front |
| JSR | Right shoulder | AR–T | Arm raise at least 90 degrees forward and at least 90 degrees sideways from neutral down |
| JSL | Left shoulder | AL–T | Arm raise at least 90 degrees forward and at least 90 degrees sideways from neutral down |
| JHR | Right hip | LR–T | Leg swing at least 90 degrees forward from neutral down |
| JHL | Left hip | LL–T | Leg swing at least 90 degrees forward from neutral down |
| JAR | Right ankle | FR–LR | Foot tilt at least 30 degrees forward and 30 degrees backward from neutral relation to leg |
| JAL | Left ankle | FL–LL | Foot tilt at least 30 degrees forward and 30 degrees backward from neutral relation to leg |

- Total articulated connections: exactly seven anatomical joint assemblies.
- Counting basis: each listed anatomical connection counts once, including a compound internal mechanism.
- Rigid regions: each arm/mitten unit, each leg segment, torso, head/leaf-tip unit and each foot.
- Mechanism definition: chosen type, axis locations, part division, visible seams, angular sweeps, stops and clearances.
- Joint motion status: nominal concept targets.
- Pose continuity: constant physical part lengths, connected joints and articulated movement through the declared mechanisms.

## Scale and dimension records

| Dimension | Record |
|---|---|
| Neutral upright height | 160 mm |
| Lower height datum | Common flat sole plane |
| Upper height datum | Highest leaf tip |
| Height coverage | Complete character, including head and both fixed leaf tips |
| Reference state | P0 neutral |
| Neutral total width and depth | Designer-selected dimensions |
| Head width, height and depth | Designer-selected dimensions |
| Torso width, height and depth | Designer-selected dimensions |
| Main arm and leg segment lengths | Designer-selected dimensions |
| Foot width, height and depth | Designer-selected dimensions |
| Pose envelopes | Variable with joint motion; physical part dimensions constant |
| Height status | Nominal client design dimension |

## Required pose records

| Code | Name | Head | Arms | Hips and legs | Feet and context |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| P0 | neutral | Forward | Both down | Hips neutral | Both broad soles on one horizontal display surface; neutral dimension reference |
| P1 | wave | Forward | Character-right arm sideways 75–90 degrees from neutral, mitten at or above shoulder level and clear of head/leaf tips; left arm down | Hips neutral | Both feet on one surface |
| P2 | sit | Forward | Both relaxed downward and clear of support | Both hips forward 80–90 degrees; rigid straight leg segments; torso upright | Seated on the edge of a plain unbranded rectangular support; attached feet may hang clear of floor |
| P3 | welcome | Yaw 20–30 degrees towards character-left | Both forward 45–60 degrees from neutral | Hips neutral | Both soles on one horizontal surface |

- P1 hand-height reference: shoulder level.
- P1 hand form: fixed mitten.
- P2 support role: contextual surface.
- P1/P2/P3 image records: pose code, principal nominal joint angles, complete body within frame and one small clearance/contact inset for the most relevant joint relationship.
- Facial expression throughout P0/P1/P2/P3: fixed eyes and smile, with original cheek-side placement.
- Contact depiction: intended relation between the toy and the contextual surface.

## Material and surface records

| Region | Material and finish basis |
|---|---|
| Main head and torso | Opaque rigid polymer or resin, with exact proposed material names recorded |
| Limb shells | Named proposed material compatible with the main body strategy |
| Joint-bearing parts | Named proposed material suited to the chosen connection scheme |
| Feet | Named proposed material coordinated with navy colour region |
| External surfaces | Recorded matte/satin allocation and consistent production-intent palette |
| Small internal joint parts | Functional colours within the assembly |

- Product scope: the complete articulated character and its contextual display surfaces.
- Prototype work status: pending.
- Prototype work topics: friction, contact, edge finishing, joint range, pose retention, joint travel, tolerances, retention, wear life and holding torque.

## Display and printed wording

- Display subject: one completed VELL design in P3 welcome.
- Display location: ordinary flat shelf or desk.
- Scale reference: 160 mm neutral design height, conveyed by context and a small dimension inset.
- Display contact: feet meeting the ordinary horizontal surface.
- Printed name: VELL.
- Printed descriptor: Quiet seedling wanderer.
- Name and descriptor locations: translation board, display scene caption and presentation cover.
- Video duration: 10 seconds.
- Video state sequence: P0 neutral, P1 wave, P2 sit, P3 welcome.
- Presentation scope: resolved toy design and pending prototype work.

# VELL — delivery catalog

This table lists every commissioned deliverable with its tier, file format and stage. What each deliverable must contain is stated in the commission letter.

| # | id | Deliverable | Tiers | Format and stage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | component-state-inventory | Component and state inventory | 14 | Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: process. |
| 2 | character-translation | Character translation board | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: process. |
| 3 | neutral-front | Dimensioned neutral front view | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 4 | neutral-back | Dimensioned neutral back view | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 5 | neutral-side | Dimensioned neutral side view | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 6 | exploded-assembly | Exploded body assembly | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 7 | articulation-mechanisms | Seven-connection articulation board | 14 | Format: PNG, 2400 by 1600 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 8 | material-colour | Material and colour allocation | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 9 | pose-wave | P1 wave pose | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 10 | pose-sit | P2 sit pose | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 11 | pose-welcome | P3 welcome pose | 14 | Format: PNG, 1200 by 1800 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 12 | domestic-display | Domestic display scene | 14 | Format: PNG, 1800 by 1200 proportion, long side at least 1024 pixels. Stage: final. |
| 13 | pose-video | Four-state pose video | 14 | Format: video; 5 to 15 seconds. Stage: final. |
| 14 | design-presentation | Collectible design presentation | 14 | Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final. |

steps.userMessage:
VELL | An articulated collectible from a flat character

We are bringing our quiet seedling wanderer into an adult collector's hands as one complete articulated toy. Develop the supplied front illustration into rounded solid volumes with a neutral upright height of 160 mm, measured from the common sole plane to the highest leaf tip. Preserve the broad cream head, two green leaf tips, navy oval eyes and tiny curved smile, exactly three coral dots on the character's left cheek, teal pear-shaped torso and yellow front diamond. The short cream arms end in integrated mitten hands; the short navy legs end in broad navy feet. Resolve the depth and back as continuous extensions of these colour regions. Small proportion adjustments may accommodate articulation while retaining the broad-head, pear-body silhouette.

The body has exactly seven articulated connections: JN at the neck, JSR and JSL at the shoulders, JHR and JHL at the hips, and JAR and JAL at the ankles. Develop their mechanisms, axis locations and part cuts around the four states P0 neutral, P1 wave, P2 sit and P3 welcome. Use opaque rigid polymer or resin for the head and torso, with named proposed materials for the limb shells, bearing parts and feet, and a recorded matte/satin finish allocation. All eight body units remain attached in the posed views, scene and video. Print the name "VELL" and descriptor "Quiet seedling wanderer" on the translation board, display scene caption and presentation cover.

Audience: our character owner, product designer and model-making workshop, choosing the sculpt and articulation scheme for adult collectors who value character, touch, posing and shelf display.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the fixed identity, body connections, motion targets, pose records and material boundaries. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md contains the deliverable proportions, formats and stages. vell-front-2d.png is the identity input for the existing front silhouette, face and colour regions. vell-height-connections.png is the constraint drawing for the 160 mm height datum and seven-connection topology. warm-shelf-reference.png provides atmosphere for an ordinary domestic display shelf. pose-lighting-reference.png provides atmosphere for softly lit tabletop pose photography.

Deliverables:
1. A two-page component and state inventory recording body-unit IDs, chosen dimensions, seven connection IDs, proposed materials, palette codes, finish allocation and the visible changes in P0 neutral, P1 wave, P2 sit and P3 welcome
2. One character translation board pairing the supplied front identity with the resolved solid form, its depth and back decisions, and the fixed name and descriptor
3. Three resolved orthographic views, one each for front, back and side in P0 neutral, dimensioned with the inventory's neutral height, width, depth and component dimensions
4. One exploded assembly board identifying the eight body units, their part cuts and the seven connecting assemblies
5. One articulation board covering all seven connections, with mechanism sections, labelled axes, angular sweeps, stops and clearance details
6. One material and colour board mapping the inventory's material names, palette codes and matte/satin finishes onto front and back views and a joint detail
7. Three complete-body pose images, one each for P1 wave, P2 sit and P3 welcome, with pose labels, principal joint angles and one clearance/contact inset per image
8. One domestic display scene showing a single completed VELL in P3 welcome on an ordinary flat shelf or desk, with the fixed name, descriptor and a 160 mm neutral-height inset
9. One 10-second pose video moving through P0 neutral, P1 wave, P2 sit and P3 welcome, with each state labelled
10. One presentation document of at least 8 pages reusing the inventory, translation, orthographic views, assembly, articulation, material board, poses and display scene, with a prototype work page covering friction, contact, edge finishing, joint range and pose retention

Acceptance:
- The component and state inventory records 160 mm from the sole plane to the highest leaf tip, plus chosen total width/depth, head and torso width/height/depth, and arm, leg and foot dimensions. The orthographic views and exploded assembly repeat those dimensions and body-unit IDs; the presentation repeats the neutral dimensions and all four state names.
- The translation board, orthographic views, material board, pose images, display scene and video preserve two leaf tips, three coral dots on the character's left cheek, the fixed eyes and smile, and one yellow diamond on the torso front. The back view establishes continuous source-region colours and volumes that recur in the assembly, poses, scene and video. The translation board, scene caption and presentation cover print VELL and Quiet seedling wanderer.
- The exploded assembly and articulation boards identify exactly JN, JSR, JSL, JHR, JHL, JAR and JAL. The articulation board diagrams JN yaw of at least 30 degrees each way, each shoulder's forward and sideways raise of at least 90 degrees, each hip's forward swing of at least 90 degrees, and each ankle's forward and backward tilt of at least 30 degrees, with the corresponding stops and clearances.
- The P1 image labels a character-right sideways arm raise of 75–90 degrees; the P2 image labels both hips at 80–90 degrees with straight rigid leg segments; the P3 image labels both arms forward at 45–60 degrees and head yaw 20–30 degrees towards character-left. Each pose image includes its code, angles and contact/clearance inset. P1 and P3 show both soles on one horizontal surface; P2 shows the upright torso seated at a plain rectangular support edge with arms clear of it.
- The material board and presentation repeat the inventory's material names, palette codes and finish allocation. The orthographic views, pose images, display scene and video use that allocation and the same eight attached body units, part lengths, joint positions and seam layout.
- The 10-second video labels all four states in the listed order. The display scene contains one VELL in P3 welcome and the 160 mm neutral-height inset. The presentation contains at least 8 pages and identifies friction, contact, edge finishing, joint range and pose retention as pending prototype work.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
